context: Codex CHANGES_REQUESTED (round 2) on PR #22, point 1: an earlier round appended a source_repo.role_provenance_note annotation directly into source-lock.snapshot.json to caveat its captured 'role' string. Codex correctly flagged that this broke the bundle's byte-verbatim evidence guarantee -- attestation.json.source_lock_sha256 ended up binding an annotated derivative, not the raw captured file. This sidecar restores that guarantee: source-lock.snapshot.json is back to its original byte-verbatim content (sha256 below), and the caveat lives here instead, out of band from the raw evidence.
